title: Debug Toolkit: network diagnostics for Android
description: 11 network tools in one free Android app: Wi-Fi signal, speed test, ping and traceroute, DNS, TLS certificates, HTTP, port scanner, WHOIS and LAN scanner.
heroLead: Slow Wi-Fi? A site that won't load? An API acting up? Debug Toolkit gives you 11 network tools on your Android phone, so you can find the problem without reaching for a laptop.
toolsLead: Built for developers, IT teams and anyone who wants real answers about their connection.
noRoot: No root needed. Every tool works on a standard Android device.
privacyBody: No account and no login. Analytics are opt-in, and the hosts and results you check are never collected.

cidr.name: CIDR calculator
cidr.description: Work out subnet ranges and masks

portscan.name: Port scanner
portscan.description: Check open TCP ports on a host
